description: Defines the LazyServiceRegistrar class for managing Android binder services, including registration, persistence, callbacks, and unregistering services.

classes.name: LazyServiceRegistrar
classes.description: Manages registration and lifecycle of binder services, including persistence and callbacks.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LazyServiceRegistrar.

methods.name: registerService
methods.description: Registers a binder service with optional name, isolation, and dump flags.

methods.name: forcePersist
methods.description: Sets whether the service should persist even with zero clients.

methods.name: setActiveServicesCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback invoked when active service count changes.

methods.name: tryUnregister
methods.description: Attempts to unregister all previously registered services.
